courses_owner_consistent.name: courses_owner_consistent
courses_owner_consistent.value:
("lms"."courses"."provider_type" = 'ECOSYSTEM' and "lms"."courses"."provider_id" is null and "lms"."courses"."contractor_id" is null)
        or ("lms"."courses"."provider_type" = 'PROVIDER' and "lms"."courses"."provider_id" is not null and "lms"."courses"."contractor_id" is null)
        or ("lms"."courses"."provider_type" = 'CONTRACTOR' and "lms"."courses"."contractor_id" is not null and "lms"."courses"."provider_id" is null)

budgets_rates_range.name: budgets_rates_range
budgets_rates_range.value: "budget"."budgets"."overhead_pct" between 0 and 100 and "budget"."budgets"."utility_pct" between 0 and 100 and "budget"."budgets"."tax_pct" between 0 and 100
